5437dc15: Begins processing logic to determine if a new admission record needs
 to be added, updated, or deleted based on the admission movement
 type (DGPMT) and other conditions.
6f3fd896: Declares variable DR for use with FileMan.
abe5ac3b: Checks if a valid admission movement entry exists and quits if not.
11ba6567: Finds an existing admission record for this movement.
d199a159: If an existing admission record is found, stores its IEN in DGJTDA.
a56de695: For transfer-out movements with a new admission movement entry, calls CHNG to update record if necessary.
d34d01a5: For new admission or re-admission movements with no existing record, adds a new admission record or updates an existing one.
06b57fda: For new admission movements with an existing admission record but no previous movement, deletes the existing record.
28e7c93d: For new admission movements with different data than an existing record, calls CK and CHNG to update the existing record.
d89d9fec: For re-admission movements with different data than an existing record, updates the existing record with the new patient movement data.
6ff41b08: For re-admission movements with no previous movement data but new data, adds a new admission record based on the new data.
dc0b68d2: Quits re-admission processing if certain conditions are not met.
3950b482: Stores the existing admission record IEN in DGJTCA for later update.
3bf5d4da: For specialty admission movements with different admission type data, calls CHNG to update the record.
72ee6368: For specialty admission movements with different treating specialty data but same admission type, calls CHNG to update the record.
7c9454be: Kills (removes) locally used variables.

b96e53ef: Logic to build a new admission record for movements that require one.
Retrieves data from other files to populate the new record fields.
bbcaa8b5: Obtains patient movement data to use for the new admission record.
003936cf: Obtains medical center treating specialty data for the new record.
c8b796f1: Set the ward name from the ward file based on the ward pointer.
80a6c453: Set the service name from the ward file based on the ward pointer.

4b7c0a70: If service is not defined in the ward file, try to get it from the service file using the facility pointer in the ward file. If still not found, use the first service entry in the service file.
8c84f29b: Get the treating specialty and procedure code from the clinic movement event.
062e8940: If the admission movement type indicates admission or transfer, also get the admitting diagnosis.
d372d185: If movement type is not discharge, admission or transfer, skip further processing.
8823ff76: If an existing admission record was found, skip record creation.
793f8fdb: Create a new admission record in the PTF file.
64db8615: Get the PTF status code for incomplete records.
e02fe899: Set the internal entry number for the new admission record.
c3b947cc: Set up fields for the new admission record: PTF status, admission movement, admission date/time, ward, facility, clinic, service, treating specialty, procedure, PTF status (again).
0def0681: Update the new admission record with the field values set above.
73934e3f: Clean up variables and exit.
c1d07288: Set up fields for updating an existing admission record: ward, facility.
b340475c: Set up fields for updating an existing admission record: clinic, service, treating specialty, procedure (or null if not available).
a1061950: Clean up variables and exit.
b54f525f: Exit the routine.
a02f53ea: Get the appropriate code component from the clinic event based on movement type.
f839ffb4: Translate the code component to the corresponding PTF code.
